reason: Node 1.3 unjustifiably equates 'the original unit' with an exact two-sided unit. The allowed def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra only says there is a multiplication and a unit making each matrix amplification an epsilon-C*-algebra; it does not specify the exact-unit condition. Moreover, def-delta-projection explicitly distinguishes the exact-unit case, where the complement retains delta, from the general case, where its defect is delta+O(epsilon_X). Hence from node 1.1 with delta=C_proj*epsilon_X and the choice C_np:=C_proj one cannot conclude that I_X-P_0 is a C_np*epsilon_X-projection. At best the cited definition gives a larger unspecified universal coefficient after an explicit constant enlargement; the present inference and constants do not establish the stated conclusion.
